problem_type: Manual creation incorrectly dispatches an Agent generation intent
symptom: The original sidebar New Storyboard button starts chat instead of opening a new blank plan.
direct_cause: createDesignForDocument defers storyboardPlannerLauncher; addStoryboardDesign without source copies an existing plan or returns null for an empty document.
class_root: The manual creation boundary does not distinguish a fresh empty object from explicit duplication or Agent authoring.
affected_population: New and existing documents, repeated manual creation, legacy and Run selections
internal_only_reason: This is the user-approved local creation contract; reuse existing store, blank-plan constructor and original editor without new dependency APIs.
invariants: Manual creation appends a stable blank design to the explicit existing document and selects it without Agent requests or node creation.
Explicit duplication preserves source fields and existing plans; missing documents do not mutate state.

door_reduction.why_not: Machine map after wiring includes sidebar subscription and manual command plus the existing explicit duplicate call. These distinct UI commands converge on the same original owner; no second writer was introduced.

generality_proof: The original store owns blank-versus-copy semantics for every caller; the sidebar reuses it and the original selection path for every document.

shared_boundaries.responsibility: Create a new stable design using explicit source or the existing empty-plan constructor.
Dispatch the manual UI intent to the original local owner and original editor.

same_class_entry_points.evidence: All document New Storyboard buttons share this handler.
Passes an explicit source plan to addStoryboardDesign; preserve copy semantics.
Explicit Agent authoring remains an intentional model request; remove only the sidebar misuse.

recurrence.reason: Every manual create click can repeat the incorrect intent, including documents without an existing plan.
same_class_scan: node scripts/door-map.mjs addStoryboardDesign; followed duplicateStoryboardDesign, sidebar data-add-storyboard and ProjectAgentResidentShell/WorkbenchEditor storyboardPlannerLauncher callers.

prevention.invariant: No implicit copying or Agent dispatch when creating without a source.
prevention.failure_mode: Return null for a missing document; sidebar leaves navigation unchanged.
prevention.strategy: Use the existing constructor in the existing mutation owner and remove the deferred Agent route from manual creation.

legacy_paths.rationale: Remove setTimeout planner dispatch from manual creation; retain intentional Agent and duplicate actions.

dependency_lifecycle.rationale: Internal dispatch and store semantics; no third-party runtime defect.

migration: No persisted schema changes or project migration; append new designs through the existing save owner.
residual_risks: Actual-entry red: /private/tmp/nomi-blank-plan-electron-red/report.json (0 plans, 1 text request); green: /private/tmp/nomi-blank-plan-electron-green-v2/report.json (four plans, cold restore, zero requests).
Initial documents are isolated fixtures; original document creation and same-title scenarios are not proven. Broader A plus T7 acceptance remains incomplete, including real resource retry.
Explicit author edits retain the baseline read-through shot_table view; only no-source blank creation skips projection. No media nodes or submissions are permitted by the new test.

invariant_owner_layer.rationale: Store owns new identity and source semantics; full UI entry test prevents a correct store from hiding wrong button dispatch.
